testId: testim-migrated/tests/admin/sales-rep/sales-rep-user-association.spec.ts > Admin - Sales Rep > Z10-TC-23095 sales rep moved from all stores to one store is offered only there

scenario.summary: A sales rep on All Stores is changed to store A only; afterwards a store A user's popup lists the sales rep and a store B user's popup does not.
steps: Setup: on the sales rep's (@rep.userId) Manage page check All Stores, Save and Close; check it is on All Stores.
Manage page: uncheck All Stores; select store A (@storeA.name); Save and Close.
Open the store A user (@userA.userName); click the search icon next to Sales Rep.
Open the store B user (@userB.userName); click the search icon next to Sales Rep.
stateChanges: The sales rep goes to All Stores, then to store A only (rep and users deleted at teardown).
assertions: The sales rep appears for association in store A
The sales rep is not available for association in store B
evidence: Story Z10-28590 (Stabilize Sales Rep Workflow), data-needs analysis work/stories/Z10-28590/analysis.md section 9 (group B remainder) and answers in sections 6 and 9.3.
Test case Z10-TC-23095 (AIO export): 'Power Tools' is its example store; store A plays it.
Precondition 'initially All Stores': set in the UI by the test and checked before the first step (user decision 2026-11-25, analysis 9.3); the approved key creates single-store reps.
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store the migrated suites run on (store A). Store B: STORE_WEBSTORE_ACTIVE with exceptPortalId = @storeA.portalId (any other active webstore).
Admin session: the suite's saved admin session (admin.setup.ts), a credential, not a need.
